Repository URL: GitHub repo for the open-source version
Method of Attack: steals sensitive information from a Windows-based host (e.g., passwords, credit cards, cookies and session data, and general keylogging)
spawns itself in a new process
collects system information (Windows version, UUID, Clipboard images, basic system info, physical disk info, user info, firewall status, WLAN status and profile)
takes a screenshot of the screen
creates a folder named with the host’s UUID to store collected data before sending it back to the TA-controlled Discord channel
